A '''graveyard''' was revered by the locals of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Temesher]], who buried their warriors there. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], large seams of [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] ore were discovered beneath the graveyard, and the local government was convinced by outsiders to allow mining there.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Blades to Be}}</ref>
